text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ——————...Where should I look back from?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right.
First... I must see her through these three years—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —At journey's end, I saw gold.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: With that in my heart, I'm setting off on my next journey. ...And that's why—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: If fate allows, we'll meet again. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A short while after that 'Arima Kinen,'
Stay Gold left those words behind
and went on an extended rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many lamented it.
On the other hand, the brilliance she left behind
has undeniably etched an indelible mark on the racing world—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Time marches on.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "—Dream Journey magnificently achieves the Grand Prix Spring-Autumn double sweep—!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...They appear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Drawn to Stay Gold, there are those who inherit her way of running.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Burn it into your memory!!
THIS is Orfevre—!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Eventually, that would create
a brand new streak of gold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a long, long time...
continuing to bring dreams to the racing world, shining as a brilliance that one cannot help but love—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, countless eras passed.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Are you finally departing?
choice_data_list: Yeah, we've reached a good stopping point, after all
Yeah, we've reached a good stopping point, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I will witness what Stay Gold left behind.
And I will bring those stories back as a souvenir.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I've already witnessed more dazzling brilliance than I can hold. ...I suppose it's time.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Deliver the message to him.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Your gold is nothing more than that of a kingless era.
...I shall personally make you understand that.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I had hoped to provide you with a clue, but...
I suppose that's unnecessary for you."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Because no one in this world shares a deeper bond
with that person than you do.
――All riiiight~♪ Safe by the skin of my teeth!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Yo! Heard it's time to set sail!
As a parting gift from Golshi-chan,
I'm giving ya some herbs that make meat crazy tough!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Telling me to go visit that Gold Geezer
while chomping on meat tenderized with this? Damn it all!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What part of that is a farewell gift?!
Good grief—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please take care on your way.
I shall remain here,
praying for the peace and safety of both you and her!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Wanna make a bet?
I bet they're fast asleep.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you can tell me the results whenever.
Well, if it hit, treat me to a meal or something.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Safe travels.
If you're free in a hundred years, let's meet up again.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Stego-san's Trainer!
I've been waiting for you~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: We all made a message board together! Please, please take it with you!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I slipped in a photo of myself as well.
...That way, you can gaze upon my beauty anytime you wish.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If you ever feel anxious on your journey, just look upon this.
My brilliance will always illuminate your path!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't think you can just win and run away.
Next time, I'm definitely taking you down.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Make sure to tell her that, okay?
She seems like the type to really care about that kind of closure.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Please have a safe trip!
May you have a wonderful journey!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, Trainer!
The day is finally upon us!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I made good-luck charms to wish you a safe journey!
I made one for you too, Stego-san, so please take it with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You must tell me both of your stories someday, alright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall wait for a long, looooong time.
Waiting is my specialty, so please don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I pray that
you will be greeted by a wonderful view.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Have a safe and pleasant journey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Good grief—
You really do let yourself get dragged around endlessly, don't you?"
choice_data_list: That's what makes it so fascinating, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In the whole wide world,
you're probably the only one who could say that with a smile.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"From me, just my gratitude.
...Truly, that is more than enough."

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-sama.
I will ensure their story is passed down forever.

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: So, please enjoy yourself without any worries. ...Also, just one thing—

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Could you please tell him...
that I'd love to hear him play that harmonica again someday?"

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
I will wait for you. Always. Forever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, Trainer.
――Have a safe trip.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ......Come, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Relying on the feelings deep within my chest—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
I sure have come a long way.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Beyond the setting sun—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......Are you there? Out there—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
............Haha.
Well, I guess it doesn't matter whether I'm here or not.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: There's no denying this is where I'm closest to reaching it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe it was the same for them.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The radiance I witnessed at the end of my journey
is the exact same as what you saw at yours—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It was a blessing for the time built up
and the glory that had been attained.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the only reason I managed to make it there...
is because of the bonds you forged for me.”

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And the encounters with friends, too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Races with your rival too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Miracles. Aspirations. Everything.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
All of it...
Without the you from another world,
I never would have been able to meet them—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, "Stay Gold".

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...
for showing me a glimpse of that.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
......And.
That's precisely why I have to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Because I'm me————I was able to run this journey.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It was because of who I am that I was able to meet her.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I was able to go on a journey with her.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The journey I shared with her...
is mine alone, something you never had.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It is my very own——————gold.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, "Stay Gold".

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: My journey isn't half bad either, right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......Is everything really completely blank now?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's over...—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...We really have come a long way...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Still, what a gorgeous sky... With a sunset that feels like the edge of the world...—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll sleep... a little...—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, whoa...
...Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha——!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
“ARE YOU KIDDING MEEEEEE!!!?
Why the heck are you hereeeeeee!!!?”
choice_data_list: Because I just can't wait any longer!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Run. Run. Run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To Stay Gold's side, to the place where that precious, one-and-only being stands—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha...!
No really, you've definitely got a screw loose!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No way... To think you'd chase me
all the way out here—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ......That's quite impressive.
choice_data_list: Because I'm your fellow traveler, after all.
Because I'm your companion on this journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the past, in the present, and forevermore.
That will not change. Nor do I intend to change it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: You are my one and only companion on this path.
choice_data_list: I have so many travel stories I want to share with you.
I have so many travel stories I want to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Me too.
So... let's talk about it on the journey ahead."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The wind blows. The time has come. Follow your heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Now, one journey has reached its end————

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Now, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ———————An endless journey begins.
